targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN NOW() - last_seen > INTERVAL '90 seconds' THEN 'Offline'
    ELSE 'Online'
  END
FROM device_status
WHERE device_id = '$device';

SELECT "Diagnóstico" FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS ord,
    CASE
      WHEN ds.state = 'FAULT'
        THEN COALESCE(dcf.diagnostic_text, ds.last_diag_message)
      ELSE COALESCE(dch.diagnostic_text, ds.health_message, ds.state)
    END AS "Diagnóstico"
  FROM device_status ds
  LEFT JOIN diagnostic_catalog dcf ON dcf.code = ds.last_diag_code
  LEFT JOIN diagnostic_catalog dch ON dch.code = ds.health_code
  WHERE ds.device_id = '$device'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 2 AS ord, dc.diagnostic_text AS "Diagnóstico"
  FROM device_status ds
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(ds.secondary_diag_codes, '[]'::jsonb)) sc
  JOIN diagnostic_catalog dc ON dc.code = sc
  WHERE ds.device_id = '$device' AND ds.state != 'FAULT'
) x
ORDER BY ord;

SELECT
  biz_risk_level AS "Riesgo"
FROM device_status
WHERE device_id = '$device';

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN last_seen IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - last_seen)) / 60, 1)
  END AS minutos_sin_senal
FROM device_status
WHERE device_id = '$device';

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN health_status IS NULL THEN 'SIN DATOS'
    ELSE health_status
  END
FROM device_status
WHERE device_id = '$device';

SELECT
  COALESCE(health_status, 'UNKNOWN') AS health_status
FROM device_status
WHERE device_id = '$device';

SELECT "Acción recomendada" FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON ("Acción recomendada") "Acción recomendada", ord
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN ds.state = 'FAULT'
          THEN COALESCE(dcf.action_text, ds.last_action)
        ELSE COALESCE(dch.action_text, ds.health_action, ds.last_action, 'Sin acción requerida')
      END AS "Acción recomendada",
      1 AS ord
    FROM device_status ds
    LEFT JOIN diagnostic_catalog dcf ON dcf.code = ds.last_diag_code
    LEFT JOIN diagnostic_catalog dch ON dch.code = ds.health_code
    WHERE ds.device_id = '$device'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT dc.action_text, 2 AS ord
    FROM device_status ds
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(ds.secondary_diag_codes, '[]'::jsonb)) sc
    JOIN diagnostic_catalog dc ON dc.code = sc
    WHERE ds.device_id = '$device' AND ds.state != 'FAULT'
  ) x
  ORDER BY "Acción recomendada", ord
) y
ORDER BY ord
LIMIT 2;

SELECT
  tds_out_ppm AS "TDS Salida"
FROM telemetry_quality
WHERE device_id = '$device'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  flow_permeate_lpm     AS "Permeado",
  flow_reject_lpm  AS "Rechazo"
FROM telemetry_process
WHERE device_id = '$device'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  MAX(volume_permeate_l) - MIN(volume_permeate_l) AS "Litros hoy"
FROM telemetry_process
WHERE device_id = '$device'
  AND time >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires');

Porcentaje de agua de entrada que se convierte en agua purificada.
Valores bajos indican desperdicio; valores altos pueden generar incrustaciones en la membrana.
Rango óptimo típico: 50–75%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  recovery * 100 AS "Recovery (%)"
FROM metrics
WHERE device_id = '$device'
  AND recovery IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

panels.title: ⚙️ Recuperación

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  efficiency * 100 AS "Eficiencia (%)"
FROM device_status
WHERE device_id = '$device';

SELECT
  delta_pressure_bar
FROM metrics
WHERE device_id = '$device'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  time,
  delta_pressure_bar
FROM metrics
WHERE device_id = '$device'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  time,
  efficiency
FROM metrics
WHERE device_id = '$device'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  MAX(volume_reject_l) - MIN(volume_reject_l) AS "Litros desperdiciados"
FROM telemetry_process
WHERE device_id = '$device'
  AND time >= date_trunc('day', NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires');

SELECT
  biz_waste_pct AS "% Desperdicio"
FROM device_status
WHERE device_id = '$device';

SELECT
  COALESCE(pressure_ok, pressure_switch)        AS "Presión OK",
  COALESCE(raw_water_available, raw_water_ok)   AS "Agua disponible",
  demand                                         AS "Demanda",
  COALESCE(well_low_level, feed_tank_level_low) AS "Nivel pozo",
  COALESCE(dosing_ok, dose_ok)                  AS "Dosificación",
  softener_regenerating                          AS "Ablandador",
  permeate_tank_low                              AS "Tanque permeado",
  permeate_tank_demand                           AS "Demanda permeado",
  final_tank_demand                              AS "Demanda final",
  phase_failure                                  AS "Falla de fase"
FROM telemetry_inputs
WHERE device_id = '$device'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  COALESCE(low_pressure_pump, pump_low)    AS "Bomba baja presión",
  COALESCE(high_pressure_pump, pump_high)  AS "Bomba alta presión",
  COALESCE(well_pump, pump_inlet)          AS "Bomba de pozo",
  transfer_pump                            AS "Bomba transferencia",
  COALESCE(flush_valve, valve_flush)       AS "Válvula flush",
  COALESCE(inlet_valve, valve_inlet)       AS "Válvula entrada",
  COALESCE(dosing_pump, pump_dose)         AS "Bomba dosificadora"
FROM telemetry_outputs
WHERE device_id = '$device'
ORDER BY time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    d.device_id AS __value,
    COALESCE(d.display_name, d.device_id) AS __text
FROM devices d
LEFT JOIN clients c ON d.client_id = c.id
WHERE d.enabled = TRUE
  AND (${__org.id} = 1 OR c.grafana_org_id = ${__org.id})
ORDER BY COALESCE(d.display_name, d.device_id)
